fol.notes: TBox subject insert. Coins (and the Black Death's arrival) are one uninterpreted sort; the classes are Bool predicates. The edit is the class axiom plus what the record's chain marks as edit ('the Ostrel find adds at least one more'): the find holds a coin (ostrel_1, a Skolem constant) and its coins are newly found, none of the three known florins. q1: the florin was struck in 1344 (authorised and issued that year; occurred_in_year is the year a coin was struck) and the Black Death reached England in 1348, both firm; 1344 < 1348 is built-in arithmetic over values nothing changes. q2, q3: the three known florins are distinct and are all the known ones (presuppositions); w1 stores the count as a figure, w2 the counting rule over the named coins (each counted once). q3's prompt gives the find's size: two coins, ostrel_1 and ostrel_2, and no other.
